messages:
sara_support: FYI customer (AcmePayments) reports sharp p95/p99 regressions after switching to our int8 quant profile yesterday. They say p95 went from ~120ms to ~420ms for chat completions. Rolling this up to infra/ML since they attached trace IDs.

mike_oncall: ack. can you paste the trace IDs + route config? any recent rollout? :eyes:

sara_support: trace: trace-ACME-0972, trace-ACME-0973. Route: /v1/chat/completions -> model: redwood-7b-v2-qint8 (profile: q-profile-v3). customer enabled "auto-quant": true in their deployment. No infra rollout on our side at the same time.

anika_ml: thanks. quick hypothesis: calibration may have fallen back to a micro-code path that disables fused attention optimizations, causing token-step kernel to switch to slower path. any kernel logs from the runtime? raj, can you pull the serving logs for those traces?

raj_runtime: pulled logs for trace-ACME-0972. snippets: 
```
2026-02-14T16:02:11Z INFO serving: model variant redwood-7b-v2-qint8 selected
2026-02-14T16:02:11Z WARN quant: calibration incomplete (samples=3, required=64)
2026-02-14T16:02:11Z INFO runtime: falling back to dequantize-on-the-fly path
2026-02-14T16:02:11Z DEBUG kernels: kernel_attention_generic launched (no fused kernels)
2026-02-14T16:02:12Z METRICS p50=90ms p95=410ms p99=870ms
```
Looks like calibration failed due to too-small sample set, so runtime chose a conservative dequant path that avoids KV cache fusion. Matches the p95 spike.

anika_ml: that fits. calibration failing -> runtime disables some quant fused kernels -> per-token cost up. why did calibration only see 3 samples? typically calibration runs as a background job seeded by first N requests or a batch calibration job.

sara_support: customer says they hit traffic spike and restarted pods, might've cleared calibration cache. they only had a small test set for calibration.

mike_oncall: can we mitigate for the customer ASAP? recommended steps: 1) force model fallback to fp16 for the customer route 2) re-run calibration with explicit dataset 3) increase calibration sample target and persist cache. can we do 1 now?

raj_runtime: I can toggle a feature flag per-customer: set route override model_variant -> redwood-7b-v2-fp16. Doing a short window rollback now. Setting: 
```
POST /admin/feature-override
{ "customer_id": "acme-123", "route": "/v1/chat/completions", "model_variant": "redwood-7b-v2-fp16", "reason": "latency emergency" }
```
Will push in 30s.

anika_ml: while rollback is in flight, we should prepare a proper calibration job and a reproducible script for the customer. propose steps:
- collect ~1k diverse prompts from their traffic (strip PII)
- run offline calibration with our calibration tool: `calibrate_quant.py --model redwood-7b-v2 --profile q-profile-v3 --samples 1024`
- validate output latency vs fp16 and generate quant profile artifact to persist to S3

sara_support: customer ok with rollback to fp16 and wants timeline for re-enabling int8. also asked for the minimal steps to avoid this in future.

mike_oncall: action items: raj to confirm rollback + confirm new p95, anika to own calibration job and write runbook for customers, sara to update customer and ask for sample prompts. I'll monitor for 2 hours.

raj_runtime: rollback applied. new metrics from same trace window: p50=88ms p95=125ms p99=260ms. tagging: :white_check_mark:

anika_ml: starting calibration job now with synthetic seeds while we get customer prompts. command used: 
```
python tools/calibrate_quant.py --model redwood-7b-v2 --profile q-profile-v3 --input-seed synthetic_traffic.json --samples 2048 --output quant_profiles/acme-123-v3.json
```
Will validate in staging before handing to customer.

sara_support: customer updated: "rollback helped, we can keep fp16 for now. please advise when safe to try int8 again."

mike_oncall: recommended runbook for customer (short):
1) do not enable auto-quant without persistent calibration store (s3/kvs)
2) run offline calibration with >=1k representative samples
3) verify perf in staging under representative batch sizes and caches
4) toggle feature flag during low-traffic window and monitor p95/p99 for 1 hour

anika_ml: noted. I'll add a new config flag in calibration tool: `--persist-to-s3` and improve validation checks so the runtime refuses to enable aggressive fused kernels unless calibration sample coverage >= threshold. filing ticket: ML-quant-298 (adds validation + clearer logs).

raj_runtime: also adding runtime guard: if calibration incomplete, expose a metric `quant.calibration_status` and do not auto-switch to fused kernels for production routes. raising a small hotfix PR now.

sara_support: thanks team. I'll close the escalation once we publish the runbook and customer confirms. tagging follow-ups: @anika_ml (calibration job + runbook), @raj_runtime (hotfix + metric), @mike_oncall (monitoring). :thumbsup:
